content: You have built castles on shifting sand and forgotten the stone foundation of eternal consciousness.
author: Kabir
explanation: Pouring all your vital energy into accumulating temporary social status and financial fortresses while ignoring your spiritual foundation leaves you defenseless when time sweeps them away.
practicalInsight: Evaluate your priorities for the upcoming month. Ensure your daily calendar reflects what has eternal value rather than only transient demands.
reflectionPrompt: What am I building on shifting sand that will not endure?
